native_peer_finite_predicate: With a present legacy board, the facade lstat-checks that board for regular type and reparse metadata. It selects LegacyClient when the native work peer is absent, or when that peer passes isdir, fails islink and has an empty scandir result. A nondirectory, islink peer or nonempty peer raises dual-owner conflict; facade scan errors propagate. The projection helper uses the same finite peer predicate and treats lstat/scan errors as a nonlegacy indication. The native peer has no explicit Windows junction/reparse lstat check. Legacy updates use per-block board SHA rather than native revision.
storage_and_concurrency_limits: Persona record write failure attempts durable stale-record invalidation; simultaneous update and invalidation denial can leave stale last-delivery record and suppress future return persona. Fixed bounded diagnostic does not prove future process forgets it.
Persona generation map is read/modify/atomic replace, without global multi-session serialization; no arbitrary concurrent delivery ordering or monotonic-generation guarantee.
Mode per-session write/readback is not an atomic multi-file marker+audit+delivery transaction. Pending queue staging is best effort and max8 can discard old rows with aggregate note.
Owned global statusline refresh compares a reread before save; no lock across external editors and no OS-wide settings transaction.
Pre-push supports Git-generated ref protocol; arbitrary malformed direct stdin/read failure is not a fail-closed parser guarantee.
Unkeyed SHA256 identity/CAS binds content, not a security boundary against an authorized malicious filesystem writer.
Detached -B prohibits normal import bytecode for that launch; it neither proves all actors preserve package bytes nor attributes original archive drift to that sole writer.

Mode transition pair is staged only after marker readback; a crash in that gap, dual queue+append denial, cap eviction or concurrent queue overwrite can lose reconstructable prior exit. Guidance expressly conditions replay on transition-owned retained rows.
Shared-reader regularity/identity guards operate on leaves and available flags; no ancestor confinement, immutable content snapshot or universal Windows nofollow/nonblocking guarantee.
